name: Apple
look: Photography-first tiles alternating light and near-black, one blue accent, tight negative tracking.

hero.title: Light, rewritten.
hero.sub: A ten-element lens, a sensor that sees three stops further into the dark, and a body milled from a single block of aluminium.

features.title: Every part considered.
features.sub: Nothing added that could be removed. Nothing removed that earns its place.

items.title: Ten-element lens
items.body: A stacked aspherical group corrects for coma and field curvature edge to edge, wide open.

items.title: Silicon that sees
items.body: A dedicated image pipeline processes fourteen frames before the shutter sound finishes.

items.title: All-day power
items.body: A thirty-two hour capture cycle from a battery that charges to eighty percent in twenty minutes.

items.title: Sealed throughout
items.body: Twelve gaskets and a machined labyrinth seal rate the body to two metres for thirty minutes.

items.title: Continuity
items.body: Every frame lands on your other devices before you have lowered the camera.

items.title: Made responsibly
items.body: The enclosure is milled from certified recycled aluminium in a facility running on renewable power.

showcases.title: Milled from a single block.
showcases.body: The enclosure begins as a solid billet of recycled aluminium and ends 41 minutes of machining later as a body with no seams, no fasteners and no flex.
points: Bead-blasted and anodised in four finishes
Sapphire crystal over every optical surface

showcases.title: Three stops further into the dark.
showcases.body: A back-illuminated sensor with larger photosites gathers more of what little light there is, then a computational pipeline stacks frames without smearing anything that moved.

metric_lead: Measured in Apertures Labs against the previous generation

gallery.title: Shot on Aperture.
gallery.sub: A selection from photographers working in the field this season.

testimonial.quote: I stopped carrying a second body. That is the whole review — there is nothing this one cannot do that I used to need two bags for.
testimonial.name: Marta Lindqvist

pricing.title: Choose your Aperture.
pricing.sub: Three bodies. One lens mount. Trade in your current camera and pay less.

tiers.name: Aperture
tiers.desc: The full sensor and lens system in an aluminium body.

tiers.name: Aperture Pro
tiers.desc: Adds the pro pipeline and 8K capture.

items.a: Every lens made for the previous mount fits without an adapter and retains autofocus and stabilisation. Third-party lenses on the same mount are supported but not calibrated at the factory.

items.q: What is included in the box?
items.a: The body, a braided charge cable, the strap and the printed guide. A power adapter is sold separately, which keeps roughly 600 tonnes of material out of the supply chain each year.
Answer four questions about the camera you own, receive an estimate immediately, and the credit is applied at checkout. The value is confirmed when the device arrives.
Yes. The battery, sensor assembly, card door and rear screen are all serviceable modules, and the parts and manuals are sold to independent repair shops.

cta.title: Aperture Pro. Available now.
cta.sub: Order today for delivery within two business days, or find it at a store near you.

footer.tagline: Designed in a small studio. Made responsibly.

notes: The section rhythm is the layout: light hero → dark product tile → light utility tile → dark tile → parchment footer. The colour change is the divider; do not add rules between sections.
One blue accent carries every interactive element. There is no second brand colour anywhere in the system.
Two button grammars only — small blue pills for calls to action, compact rounded rectangles for utility.
Exactly one drop shadow exists in the whole system, and it is reserved for a product image that needs to breathe.
Negative tracking at display sizes produces the tight headline feel; body text stays at normal tracking.
